title: CNC AGI Bakeoff
description: Bakeoff harness for evaluating CAD generation candidates against canonical CNC cases. No external model APIs are called by default; command candidates require --allow-commands.

cases.prompt: Generate a rectangular plate 100mm x 60mm x 6mm with four through holes of 6mm diameter at corners 8mm from edges. Use cadquery.
Generate an L-bracket 80mm x 60mm x 8mm thickness with two elongated slots 12mm x 6mm on the vertical face and two counterbored holes on the horizontal face. Use cadquery.
Generate a rectangular plate 120mm x 80mm x 10mm with a rectangular pocket 60mm x 40mm x 4mm deep centered on the top face. Use cadquery.
Generate a circular flange 80mm diameter x 10mm thick with a 20mm center hole and six 6mm bolt holes evenly spaced on a 60mm bolt circle. Use cadquery.
Generate a V-block 80mm x 40mm x 40mm with a 90-degree V-groove along the center of the top face, 20mm deep. Use cadquery.

candidates.name: Existing Qwen Generation (local)
candidates.description: Uses existing generation from artifacts/hector-qwen-cad-generation/generation.json. No external API call.

candidates.name: Placeholder Command Candidate
candidates.description: Template for future model invocation. Disabled by default; use --allow-commands to enable.

candidates.name: Local CadQuery Runner (disabled)
candidates.description: Runs local_cadquery_runner for prompt-based CAD generation. Disabled by default.
